QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (`mbedtls_config.h:3783-2196`) or `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT`. Both are off by default."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that THREADING_C is commented out in the shipped config and that the PTHREAD and ALT backends are both off by default, so the default build defines none of the threading macros.
